for label,binary,command in [('git','/usr/bin/git','cherry-pick'),('before',str(root/'grit-main-verified'),'pick'),('after',str(root/'grit-after-scoped'),'pick')]:
 prep=plan['prepare'];subprocess.run([prep['program']]+prep['args'],cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)

 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/git','fsck','--strict','--no-progress'],cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)
